name: Mixing & Mastering Demo - Notion neuer Eingang (Zeitplan)

parameters.query:
WITH gate AS (
  SELECT started_at FROM public.notion_sync_settings
  WHERE id = true AND started_at IS NOT NULL
), candidate AS (
  SELECT i.id, 'notion_sync_v1:' || i.id::text || ':' || i.status || ':' ||
  to_char(i.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS') AS revision_key
  FROM public.inquiries i CROSS JOIN gate s
  WHERE i.email_verified_at IS NOT NULL
    AND i.status IN ('evaluating', 'awaiting_owner_review',
                     'awaiting_customer', 'ready_for_processing', 'manual_review')
    AND i.created_at >= s.started_at
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.outbound_actions a
      WHERE a.idempotency_key = 'notion_sync_v1:' || i.id::text || ':' || i.status || ':' ||
  to_char(i.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS'))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.outbound_actions a
      WHERE a.inquiry_id = i.id AND a.kind = 'notion_upsert'
        AND a.state <> 'succeeded')
    AND NOT (i.notion_page_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.outbound_actions a
      WHERE a.inquiry_id = i.id AND a.kind = 'notion_upsert'
        AND a.state = 'succeeded' AND a.external_reference IS NOT NULL))
  ORDER BY i.updated_at, i.id
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE OF i SKIP LOCKED
), planned AS (
  INSERT INTO public.outbound_actions
    (inquiry_id, kind, idempotency_key, state, attempt_count, last_attempt_at)
  SELECT id, 'notion_upsert', revision_key, 'in_progress', 1, now()
  FROM candidate
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id, inquiry_id
)
SELECT p.id::text AS action_id, i.id::text AS inquiry_id,
       i.notion_page_id
FROM planned p JOIN public.inquiries i ON i.id = p.inquiry_id;

nodes.name: Verknuepfte Seite und aktuellen Stand laden

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT ($1::jsonb->>'action_id')::uuid AS action_id
), invalid AS (
  UPDATE public.outbound_actions a
  SET state = 'needs_review', last_error_code = 'notion_page_link_lost'
  FROM incoming p, public.inquiries i
  WHERE a.id = p.action_id AND i.id = a.inquiry_id
    AND a.kind = 'notion_upsert' AND a.state = 'in_progress'
    AND (i.notion_page_id IS NULL OR i.notion_page_id !~*
      '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')
  RETURNING a.id
)
SELECT a.id::text AS action_id, i.id::text AS inquiry_id,
       i.notion_page_id, i.status, i.selected_service, i.confirmed_service,
       i.service_unklar, i.first_name || ' ' || i.last_name AS customer_name,
       i.email, i.message, i.download_url,
       to_char(i.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
         'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS updated_at
FROM incoming p
JOIN public.outbound_actions a ON a.id = p.action_id
JOIN public.inquiries i ON i.id = a.inquiry_id
WHERE a.kind = 'notion_upsert' AND a.state = 'in_progress'
  AND i.notion_page_id ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$';

nodes.name: Neue Seiten-ID sichern und aktuellen Stand laden

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS value
), parsed AS (
  SELECT (value->>'action_id')::uuid AS action_id,
         NULLIF(value->>'page_id', '') AS page_id
  FROM incoming
), linked AS (
  UPDATE public.inquiries i
  SET notion_page_id = p.page_id
  FROM parsed p JOIN public.outbound_actions a ON a.id = p.action_id
  WHERE i.id = a.inquiry_id
    AND a.kind = 'notion_upsert' AND a.state = 'in_progress'
    AND i.notion_page_id IS NULL
    AND p.page_id ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  RETURNING i.id, i.notion_page_id
), failed AS (
  UPDATE public.outbound_actions a
  SET state = 'needs_review',
      last_error_code = CASE WHEN p.page_id IS NULL THEN 'notion_create_error'
                             ELSE 'notion_create_reconcile_required' END,
      external_reference = p.page_id
  FROM parsed p
  WHERE a.id = p.action_id AND a.kind = 'notion_upsert'
    AND a.state = 'in_progress' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM linked)
  RETURNING a.id
)
SELECT a.id::text AS action_id, i.id::text AS inquiry_id,
       l.notion_page_id, i.status, i.selected_service, i.confirmed_service,
       i.service_unklar, i.first_name || ' ' || i.last_name AS customer_name,
       i.email, i.message, i.download_url,
       to_char(i.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
         'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS updated_at
FROM linked l
JOIN parsed p ON true
JOIN public.inquiries i ON i.id = l.id
JOIN public.outbound_actions a ON a.id = p.action_id
WHERE a.kind = 'notion_upsert' AND a.state = 'in_progress';

WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS value
), parsed AS (
  SELECT (value->>'action_id')::uuid AS action_id,
         NULLIF(value->>'page_id', '') AS page_id
  FROM incoming
), recorded AS (
  UPDATE public.outbound_actions a
  SET state = CASE WHEN p.page_id = i.notion_page_id
                       AND a.idempotency_key = 'notion_sync_v1:' || i.id::text || ':' || i.status || ':' ||
  to_char(i.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS')
                   THEN 'succeeded' ELSE 'needs_review' END,
      completed_at = CASE WHEN p.page_id = i.notion_page_id
                              AND a.idempotency_key = 'notion_sync_v1:' || i.id::text || ':' || i.status || ':' ||
  to_char(i.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS')
                          THEN now() ELSE NULL END,
      external_reference = i.notion_page_id,
      last_error_code = CASE WHEN p.page_id IS NULL THEN 'notion_update_error'
                             WHEN p.page_id <> i.notion_page_id THEN 'notion_page_mismatch'
                             WHEN a.idempotency_key <> 'notion_sync_v1:' || i.id::text || ':' || i.status || ':' ||
  to_char(i.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSUS')
                               THEN 'inquiry_changed'
                             ELSE NULL END
  FROM parsed p, public.inquiries i
  WHERE a.id = p.action_id AND i.id = a.inquiry_id
    AND a.kind = 'notion_upsert' AND a.state = 'in_progress'
  RETURNING a.state, a.last_error_code, a.external_reference
)
SELECT state, last_error_code, external_reference FROM recorded;

parameters.content:
## Notion-Abgleich fuer neue Anfragen
Der Zeitplan prueft alle 5 Minuten genau eine neue oder geaenderte Anfrage. Er waehlt nur Anfragen mit `created_at >= notion_sync_settings.started_at`; solange `started_at` leer ist, verarbeitet er nichts. Erst Credentials selbst zuweisen, dann Zeitplan aktivieren und danach `started_at` in PostgreSQL auf `now()` setzen. Alte Anfragen bleiben ausgeschlossen. PostgreSQL ist massgeblich; unklare Notion-Ergebnisse landen in `needs_review` und werden nicht automatisch wiederholt. Keine E-Mail, kein OpenAI-Zugriff, kein Download.
